## What you should be able to do tonight

- Derive Black-Scholes by replication, without notes, in under ten minutes.
- Show the delta-hedging profit decomposed into the implied-realized variance gap and discrete rebalancing cost.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The drill band changes today and runs under a clock from here to July. Timed mixed set: five problems in fifteen minutes, drawn from probability, expectation and mental arithmetic, with no warning about which is which. Score yourself out of five and write it down; this number is what you are tracking now.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Market making, first sitting: I am making a market in the number of piano tuners in Chicago. Give me a two-sided quote and defend the width. Then I trade with you and you must requote. The requoting is the part candidates get wrong.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Estimation: how many options contracts trade on SPY in a day? Get within a factor of three by reasoning, not recall, then check against the Cboe market statistics page.
:::
